selected.title: His Ex Texted Me From His Phone
selected.hook: My boyfriend told me his ex was completely out of his life. Then she texted me from his phone.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend told me his ex was completely out of his life. Then she texted me from his phone.

We'd been together almost two years, and he always said their breakup was messy but final. I believed him because he never hid his phone, never disappeared, never gave me a reason not to.

Last Friday he said he was helping his brother move and would be gone most of the night. Around eleven, I got a message from his number: "You should probably ask him where he actually is."

I thought it was a joke. Then another message came through with a photo of him sitting on a couch next to his ex.

She told me he'd been coming over for weeks because they were "trying to get closure." Apparently closure involved late-night conversations, deleting messages, and telling both of us completely different stories.

When he finally came home, I didn't show him the photo. I just asked, "How's your brother's new apartment?"

He smiled and said, "Exhausting, but we got everything moved."

That's when I put my phone on the table.

He went silent for maybe ten seconds, then said, "It's not what it looks like."

I packed a bag that night.

Now he's begging me not to throw away two years over "one stupid lie."

Would you call this one lie?
